shared: random seed when the implementation exposes one
paired_design.branch_rule: factual and counterfactual must match through the causal branch frame

adherence.single: the intended entity executes its requested control
adherence.paired: the two rendered actions differ in the requested direction

physics.single: motion, scale, contact and occlusion contain no teleportation, morphing or ghost force
physics.paired: pre-branch trajectories align and post-branch trajectories bifurcate physically

environment_preservation.single: camera, background and non-target permanence remain stable
environment_preservation.paired: cross-video differences outside the affected region are minimal

outcome.paired: the final states diverge in the intervention-predicted direction

trajectory_adherence.single: ADE/FDE or state-center/yaw errors against the requested trajectory
trajectory_adherence.paired: the measured trajectory delta matches the requested delta

object_background_preservation.single: target asset identity is preserved and non-target/background content is unchanged
object_background_preservation.paired: target-only change is localized; removal reveals plausible background
